numid=4,iface=CARD,name='Headphone Jack'
  ; type=BOOLEAN,access=r-------,values=1
  : values=off
numid=3,iface=MIXER,name='Line Out Playback Switch'
  ; type=BOOLEAN,access=rw------,values=2
  : values=off,off
numid=2,iface=MIXER,name='Line Out Playback Volume'
  ; type=INTEGER,access=rw---R--,values=1,min=0,max=31,step=0
  : values=0
  | dBrange-
    rangemin=0,,rangemax=1
      | dBscale-min=-99999.99dB,step=0.00dB,mute=1
    rangemin=2,,rangemax=31
      | dBscale-min=-43.50dB,step=1.50dB,mute=0

numid=8,iface=MIXER,name='Line Out Source Playback Route'
  ; type=ENUMERATED,access=rw------,values=2,items=2
  ; Item #0 'Stereo'
  ; Item #1 'Mono Differential'
  : values=0,0
numid=6,iface=MIXER,name='DAC Playback Switch'
  ; type=BOOLEAN,access=rw------,values=2
  : values=on,on
numid=1,iface=MIXER,name='DAC Playback Volume'
  ; type=INTEGER,access=rw---R--,values=1,min=0,max=63,step=0
  : values=0
  | dBscale-min=-73.08dB,step=1.16dB,mute=0
numid=7,iface=MIXER,name='DAC Reversed Playback Switch'
  ; type=BOOLEAN,access=rw------,values=2
  : values=off,off
numid=5,iface=MIXER,name='Speaker Switch'
  ; type=BOOLEAN,access=rw------,values=1
  : values=off
